scope: One real horizontal Qt6 QSlider, generated QSS and selected KDE palette roles; no Motif guest comparison.

implementation.backdrop: A dynamic domainosBackdrop property follows top-level WindowActivate/WindowDeactivate. QSS :!active was removed from this QSlider because it matched the idle control and masked its normal role color.
implementation.geometry: The handle includes the two relief borders in its cross-axis size; QSS reserves that full space to avoid clipping.
implementation.native_input: QSlider continues to own range/value and pointer/keyboard input.

verification.qt6_recipe_tests: 15/15 passed, including normal/backdrop KDE role pixel changes and actual pointer/keyboard/press/release behavior.

limitations: No corresponding QSlider measurement/capture was taken in the Domain/OS SR10.4 VM.
Technical pass is not user visual approval.
